data.title: Technical Writer And Deliverables Lead
data.description:
A program office runs on its deliverable cadence, and the documents that carry it have to be accurate, on time, and readable by every audience that touches them. The Red Gate Group is seeking a Technical Writer and Deliverables Lead to support a Department of Defense intelligence customer, producing clear documentation that meets both technical accuracy and regulatory compliance standards while owning the recurring contract deliverable cadence for a newly established joint program office. You will produce and maintain recurring program deliverables, including monthly activity reports, quarterly business review briefs, transition plans, and project plans.


You will develop Risk Management Framework documentation in accordance with NIST SP 800-37 and DoD RMF guidance, including system security plans, security assessment reports, and authorization packages that support the Authority to Operate process. You will also translate complex technical concepts into accessible documentation for diverse audiences and support broader status reporting and project management artifact production.


You Have

• 5+ years of technical writing or IT project support experience, including recent experience within the last 2 years. This experience requirement is firm and cannot be met through education or certifications.

• Bachelor's degree in a related field, or one of the following in its place: an Associate's degree in a related field and 2 additional years of relevant experience, or 4 additional years of relevant experience. The additional years used in place of the degree are on top of the 5 year experience requirement above, not counted within it.


In plain terms: with a Bachelor's you need 5 years, with an Associate's 7, and with no degree 9.

• Demonstrated experience producing RMF documentation supporting the Authority to Operate process

• Active TS/SCI clearance with a current CI polygraph


Nice If You Have

• Experience with government CDRL formats and templates

Company Description

The Red Gate Group, founded in 2006, is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Company based in Chantilly, VA. As an SDVOSB, the Red Gate Group has established a reputation for delivering quality multi-tiered services in intelligence analysis, strategic planning, program management, policy development, operational design, and technology integration. RGG delivers high-quality, customer-centric solutions around the world—from the foxhole to the highest levels of Government. Our motto, "Making a Difference for Country and Client," reflects our deep commitment to national security and service excellence. As an employer of choice, we offer comprehensive benefits including flexible time off, 11 paid holidays, immediate 401(k) eligibility with a generous match, and full medical, dental, and vision coverage. Our employees enjoy 100% company-paid life insurance and disability benefits, along with professional development assistance for degrees and certifications. We foster a culture of growth and work-life balance, backed by our commitment to supporting both our clients' missions and our employees' success. Join our team and be part of an organization that values both service excellence and employee wellbeing.
data.summary: The Technical Writer and Deliverables Lead will support a Department of Defense intelligence customer by producing and maintaining recurring program deliverables, including reports, briefs, plans, and project artifacts. The role also develops Risk Management Framework documentation for the Authority to Operate process and translates complex technical concepts into clear documentation that meets technical and regulatory standards.

data.title: Technical Writer
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Project Manager to coordinate and manage the delivery, verification, tracking, and closeout of operational procedures supporting data center construction, expansion, retrofit, and infrastructure projects.

The Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, manage project timelines and deliverables, monitor workflow progress, facilitate meetings, maintain project documentation, and support timely resolution of project risks and operational blockers.

Key Responsibilities

Project Initiation and Planning

  • Review and triage incoming procedure delivery requests for new construction, expansion, and retrofit projects.
  • Coordinate site discovery activities and establish project tracking requirements.
  • Initiate project plans, trackers, and required project documentation.
  • Distribute and manage equipment and information questionnaires.
  • Coordinate introductory process-alignment sessions with facility operations stakeholders.

Project Execution and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Schedule and facilitate project kickoff meetings with facility representatives and subject matter experts (SMEs).
  • Coordinate recurring operational meetings to monitor procedure verification and project progress.
  • Assign and track review activities across appropriate technical or operational SMEs.
  • Maintain clear communication regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and outstanding actions.
  • Coordinate information flow among project stakeholders to support timely completion of deliverables.

Project Tracking, Risk Management, and Governance

  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and completion status.
  • Maintain project trackers and provide accurate status updates.
  • Monitor applicable Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and identify potential schedule or delivery risks.
  • Document project issues, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalate unresolved project issues through established management and governance processes.
  • Support project reporting and operational dashboards with accurate and timely information.

Workflow and Tracking Systems

  • Manage project workflow activities using applicable ticketing and task-management systems.
  • Administer workflow automation processes used for procedure delivery tracking.
  • Create and maintain child tracking items and route assigned verification activities to appropriate SMEs.
  • Maintain accurate task status, ownership, dependencies, and completion information.
  • Experience with Buganizer or similar workflow/ticketing platforms is beneficial.

Project Closeout

  • Coordinate completion of project closeout activities and checklists.
  • Track final procedure verification and required approvals/sign-offs.
  • Confirm completion of outstanding project deliverables.
  • Facilitate final project closeout and retrospective meetings with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain final project documentation and status records.

Key Deliverables

  • Site-specific procedure delivery plans and project artifacts.
  • Procedure verification trackers showing completion status across applicable operational disciplines.
  • Project status reports and milestone tracking.
  • Verification and completion metrics.
  • Project health and risk updates.
  • Accurate records within project tracking and workflow systems.
  • Completed project closeout documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in project management, program coordination, technical operations, technical documentation, infrastructure projects, or a related professional area.
  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders or functional teams.
  • Experience managing project schedules, milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies.
  • Experience using project management, ticketing, workflow, or task-management systems.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple concurrent project activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, document action items, and follow up on assigned deliverables.
  • Ability to identify project risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate them through established processes.
  • Ability to work onsite at the designated Lenoir, North Carolina data center location as required by the hybrid work arrangement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center operations, technical facilities, infrastructure engineering, construction/retrofit projects, or technical procedure/documentation programs.
  • Experience working with operational or technical SMEs.
  • Experience with Agile, operational workflow, or structured project-tracking processes.
  • Familiarity with Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and operational performance tracking.
  • Experience with Buganizer or comparable issue/task management platforms.
  • Experience coordinating procedure verification or technical documentation workflows.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • This position follows a hybrid work arrangement with required onsite work at the designated data center location.
  • The role primarily involves project coordination, communication, documentation, tracking, and stakeholder management.
  • When onsite, the individual must follow applicable site access, safety, security, and operational procedures.
  • Any additional physical or site-access requirements will be communicated as part of the applicable worksite requirements.

Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, business requirements, and applicable law. We do not discriminate on the basis of characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable accommodations may be available for qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Cranial and Spinal Technologies develops technologies and therapies used in neurosurgery, spine surgery, biologics, navigation, robotics, and enabling technologies that support patient care across a broad range of cranial and spinal procedures. This role is part of the technical publications function and is responsible for creating and maintaining Instructions for Use (IFU) and related customer-facing documentation that support the safe and effective use of advanced imaging products.

Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic CST


This position is based in Lafayette, Colorado, and requires an on-site work arrangement. Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, with expected travel less than 10%.

The Senior Technical Writer develops, maintains, and manages Instructions for Use (IFU) and related technical documentation for advanced imaging products. This role collaborates with engineering, marketing, regulatory, and quality teams to gather information, translate complex technical concepts into clear user documentation, manage document release activities, and coordinate translation projects supporting global product distribution.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and update Instructions for Use (IFU), system manuals, quick reference guides, package inserts, technical bulletins, and software help documentation.
  • Gather technical content through collaboration with product development, marketing, regulatory, and subject matter experts.
  • Create and manage structured documentation using Adobe FrameMaker, XML authoring tools, and related content management systems.
  • Manage document version control, archival activities, and documentation release processes within Product Lifecycle Management systems.
  • Coordinate translation projects, including document preparation, tracking, review, and finalization with external translation providers.
  • Review, edit, and proofread technical documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with quality requirements.
  • Support cross-functional teams with documentation-related guidance and ensure documentation is available for product releases.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance documentation quality, efficiency, and compliance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of technical writing or technical editing experience OR Master's degree and 2+ years of technical writing or technical editing experience.
  • Advanced experience with Adobe FrameMaker.
  • Experience with structured authoring, XML, and content management systems.
  • Advanced experience with Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, vector graphics software, and HTML.
  • Experience creating technical documentation for global audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical writing experience in the medical device, scientific, or other regulated industry.

data.title: Staff (technical) Writer & Editor
data.description:
About Us

FAR.AI is a non-profit AI research institute working to ensure advanced AI is safe and beneficial for everyone. Our mission is to facilitate breakthrough AI safety research, advance global understanding of AI risks and solutions, and foster a coordinated global response.

We’re structured to support that work from early research through real-world adoption:

Independent by design. We can pursue what's most impactful based on our theory of change and share what we find publicly.

A portfolio approach. Rather than focus on one single direction, we run diverse bets across the safety stack. We take promising ideas from initial experiments to deployment, informed by red-team partnerships with frontier labs and governments.

Serious infrastructure for ambitious research. A dedicated engineering team runs our compute cluster and experiment-scaling stack, so researchers spend their time on research instead of on infra.

Setting the standard. Our events convene key decision makers; our red-team works with frontier developers and governments; and our communications inform the public. Together, this drives adoption and sets the new standard in safety.

Since our founding in July 2022, we've grown to 50+ staff, published 40+ academic papers, and convened leading AI safety events. Our work is recognized globally, with publications at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML including a Best Paper Honorable Mention in 2026, and ICLR, and features in the Financial Times, Nature News, Wired Magazine and MIT Technology Review. We conduct pre-deployment testing on behalf of frontier developers such as OpenAI and independent evaluations for governments including the EU AI Office and publish the AI Security Leaderboard based on our red-teaming expertise. We help steer and grow the AI safety field through developing research roadmaps with renowned researchers such as Yoshua Bengio; running FAR.Labs, an AI safety-focused co-working space in Berkeley housing 40+ members; and supporting the community through targeted grants to technical researchers.

FAR.AI is seeking an experienced writer and editor to lead development of our written content. You will report into our Communications Team Lead and work across the communications team to shape our narrative, content and messaging. You will work closely with our researchers to translate their research findings into actionable insights for policymakers and corporate decisionmakers across formats from op-eds, blog posts and research papers. We’d love to hear from you if you thrive on communicating complicated technical subject matters and want to shape the future of AI development toward a safer trajectory.

About Communications at FAR.AI

We believe that AI will be the defining technology of the 21st century. These systems could bring with them unprecedented benefits, but they also pose unprecedented risks, up to human extinction. We already know that AI will fundamentally affect everyone’s lives, reshaping the nature of work and upending geopolitics. Yet few people outside of Silicon Valley appreciate what is about to happen. Key decisionmakers in governments and companies have a limited view on what is to come, while the general public are even more in the dark.

Communications at FAR.AI fills this urgent gap. As a research and education non-profit, we are a trusted, independent third-party that can cut through the hype, avoid fear mongering, while delivering credible warnings when a technology truly poses a danger. Our Communications Team partners directly with FAR.AI researchers to translate our work into compelling narratives that connect with our target audiences, whether policymakers, corporate decisionmakers or the general public.

The team consists of experts in design, digital media, and media relations, ensuring our research and events reach their key audiences across various channels. Communications works with key FAR.AI team members, including our CEO Adam Gleave, building and amplifying their public profiles and thought leadership. Communications is deeply embedded across FAR.AI, partnering cross-functionally to deliver strategic projects. The team develops and executes communication plans for our key initiatives, such as our leaderboard on AI model security to enable consumers and policymakers to make informed decisions on their use and governance of this technology.

About the role

FAR.AI is seeking a Staff Writer & Editor to own development of our written content. You will work with our researchers and red-team on pre-publication findings to write reports read by key policymakers and decisionmakers at frontier labs; develop content for public-facing products such as our security leaderboard; and work with our CEO and key technical leaders to write op-eds and position papers that shape the field. You will craft a compelling org-wide narrative and ensure FAR.AI’s voice remains trusted and authoritative in the field. This is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing, mission-driven organization with the unique blend of independent, trusted technical expertise; ongoing corporate and policy engagements; and a track record of reaching varied audiences.

Key responsibilities

  • (Technical version of role) Writing to the scientific community

    • Partner with our technical team early on in key research projects to identify the key narrative and message for their work.

    • Edit drafts of academic papers to more effectively convey their ideas to a scholarly audience, and structure the papers to submission standards (including working in LaTeX where needed).

    • Writing blog post summaries of papers, targeted at a technically knowledgeable (but not necessarily expert) audience (example).

    • Co-writing blog posts (example), newsletters (example) or position papers (example) with our technical team to convey key positions or ideas.

  • Content Strategy & Execution

    • Translate our core research findings into actionable insights for key non-technical audiences, e.g. policy briefs.

    • Own written content on FAR.AI’s website, our primary brand surface. Collaborate with our Digital Media Manager to shape the structure and presentation so it clearly communicates who we are and what we stand for.

    • Own our quarterly newsletter, setting the editorial direction, consolidating key updates from across the team into a clear narrative for our key supporters.

  • Voice, Narrative & Messaging

    • Work with our Communications Team Lead to establish and steward a consistent organizational voice, develop compelling narratives around our strategic priorities and key messages that support this narrative.

    • Equip staff across all teams with the messaging, framing, and confidence to represent and amplify FAR.AI’s narrative in their own work and channels.

    • Collaborate with our Digital Media Manager to ensure that our social media posts are consistent with this voice and narrative, including reviewing key posts.

About You

You are a skilled writer who is passionate about clearly communicating complex technical findings in a way that is actionable to diverse audiences. You combine crafting a compelling high-level narrative with hands-on execution and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. You will be comfortable collaborating with key stakeholders across the organization to ensure FAR.AI’s messaging is always clear, persuasive, and credible. You will set the bar for clarity, accuracy, and rigor across FAR.AI's writing.

Proactive and self-directed, you can carry several projects at once and bring each one over the finish line. You move fluidly between the rigorous and the accessible, and you treat clarity as a craft. Collaborative and detail-oriented, you make the researchers you work with sound like the best version of themselves.

We welcome applications from both experienced writers, as well as technical specialist who are skilled and passionate communicators.

We expect writers to have:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a writing role (e.g., staff writer, science communicator, editorial lead).

  • A portfolio of published work demonstrating their ability to turn complex technical material into clear, accurate writing (papers, technical reports, research blogs, or similar).

We expect technical specialists to have:

  • 3+ years of experience in machine learning or a closely related field (e.g. maths, stats, physics) as a researcher or engineer (e.g. PhD in ML; Research Engineer).

  • A portfolio of published writing across varying levels of complexity (two or more of: papers / technical documentation; blog posts; social media; op-eds; policy briefs).

We expect all candidates to have:

  • Proven ability to own projects independently from concept to completion.

  • An interest in AI safety and our mission, and a willingness to learn.

We expect strong candidates to have some, but not all, of the following:

  • Familiarity with the AI landscape and experience engaging with key stakeholders (governments, AI companies, policy think tanks).

  • Strong working understanding of machine learning concepts, sufficient to represent research accurately and converse credibly with researchers.

  • Experience with the academic publication process: arXiv, conference submissions, peer review, LaTeX.

  • Track record of writing, ghostwriting and/or editing op-eds.

  • Track record of writing to policymakers, e.g. policy briefs, especially in technology and innovation policy.

  • Background in science journalism, research communications, or as a researcher who writes.

Logistics

  • Hours and Location: This is a full-time, long-term position that can be either in-person (Berkeley, CA; or Singapore) or globally remote (with overlap with 9am-noon Pacific time). We offer visa sponsorship for in-person employees.

  • Compensation: We can offer compensation of $100,000–$200,000/year depending on experience and location, with the potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates, plus our standard benefits for US & Singapore employees which includes catered lunch and dinner at our offices in Berkeley.

  • Contractual Relationship: If based in the US or Singapore, you will be an employee of FAR.AI (501(c)(3) research non-profit / non-profit CLG). Outside the US or Singapore, you will be employed via an EOR organisation on behalf of FAR.AI or as a contractor.

  • Application process: Our application process includes a screening call, a paid 2-3h written test task, interviews with our team, and a paid full-day assessment. We expect filling out the initial application form will take less than 15 minutes.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact us at talent@far.ai. Otherwise, if you don't have questions, the best way to ensure a proper review of your skills and qualifications is by applying directly via the application form. Please don't email us to share your resume (it won't have any impact on our decision). Thank you!

data.title: Technical Writer
data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position

As a member of the Services organization’s technical writing team, you’ll serve as both an independent contributor and leader in the development, delivery, and maintenance of Field Service documentation. This role combines hands-on technical writing with responsibility for establishing documentation standards, mentoring junior writers and contractors, and driving continuous improvement in documentation processes and quality.

To be successful in this role, applicants must demonstrate independence in extracting and synthesizing complex technical information from systems, subject matter experts, field demonstrations, and laboratory environments. Strong technical judgment, combined with exceptional communication skills, enables this role to evolve with changing business needs while ensuring documentation remains accurate, clear, and usable, while staying compliant with company guidelines.

This is an on-campus position with a minimum of 3 days a week in office and laboratory environments. Hands-on lab access is essential to this role’s effectiveness.

Essential Job Duties

  • Plans, writes, edits, and maintains Field Service documentation (i.e., Field Service procedures) for medical device systems with strong independent technical judgment.
  • Independently investigates and extracts technical requirements through systems review, laboratory demonstrations, engineering consultation, and field observation. Takes ownership of information gathering rather than relying on engineers to provide pre-written content.
  • Establishes and maintains documentation standards, style guidelines, templates, and best practices. Develops and refines processes to improve team productivity and quality.
  • Mentors and coaches junior writers and contractors. Provides technical feedback, reviews documentation, and contributes to team member development.
  • Completes documentation control steps to release final documentation, tracking work in JIRA and maintaining Change Order records.
  • Collaborates across product, engineering, training, and field service teams to ensure documentation meets end-to-end needs and aligns with company goals and quality standards.
  • Evaluates and recommends process improvements, tooling enhancements, and workflow optimizations. Leads or participates in documentation infrastructure initiatives.
  • Builds and maintains technical knowledge of Intuitive Surgical hardware systems sufficient to translate complex engineering concepts for field audiences.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years technical writing experience for complex hardware and medical device products (installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently learn and understand mechanical systems through direct investigation and lab/field demonstrations.
  • Expertise in minimalist hardware documentation using DITA XML tools (Oxygen XML Editor or equivalent).
  • Professional writing samples must demonstrate technical depth, minimalist principles, and clear communication of complex concepts.
  • Exceptional writing and analytical skills; ability to grasp, validate, and effectively communicate complex scientific and engineering concepts with technical rigor.
  • Solid project-management skills; ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines and mentor others in project execution.
  • Proficiency with current Adobe tools (Acrobat, Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) for documentation graphics.
  • Medical device industry experience required. Field service or customer-facing documentation experience strongly preferred.
  • Ownership mindset, commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Technical Writing, Engineering, or related field required.

Additional Information

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

Job Summary

The Junior Technical Writer plays a critical role in ensuring that Coast Professional, Inc., is supported with the creation, editing, and maintenance of clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation.  This role works closely with the Technical Writers, along with Operation and Support teams, to ensure all materials are consistent, technically correct and aligned with organizational standards. Performs related regulatory compliance research, analysis and evaluation activities, along with data entry and tracking within the learning management system and compliance management systems. 

Job Duties and Responsibilities
  • Assist in the drafting of policies and procedures in accordance with business goals, regulatory compliance and legal requirements for all Departments of the company
  • Maintain and update existing documentation to reflect process changes
  • Develop policies that are simple and clear that are easily understood by all employees
  • Develop policies that are comprehensive and able to address questions and situations
  • Prepares, packages and presents policies and procedures to management and lines of business for review and approval
  • Conducts and attends all relevant meetings associated with job function and completes tasks correctly and timely
  • Assist in annual ISO 9001 recertification in relation to policies and procedures.
  • Monitor and update Compliance Management Systems, keeping records current and assisting with audits, reporting, and documentation required for regulatory adherence.
  • Works with the Training team and others as appropriate to ensure policies and procedures are up to date, including appropriate introductory training for new employees as well as ongoing training for all employees and managers as it relates to regulatory compliance
  • Support Technical Writers and compliance staff on larger products or tasks, as assigned
  • Track and maintain Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring training materials are up to date, properly organized, and accurately assigned.
  • Maintains cohesive working relationships with all levels of management and lines of business to effectively produce projects and deliverables.
  • Maintain records and files of work and revisions.
  • Edit, standardize, or make changes to material prepared by other writers or establishment personnel.
  • Perform other duties as required by management.
Qualifications

Education

High school diploma or GED required

Experience

Experience in collections or related profession required

Knowledge
  • Knowledge of collection practices.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft products (excel and word).
  • Ability to prioritize work.
  • Report preparations and techniques.
  • Modern office procedures, methods, and computer equipment.
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of FDCPA,FCRA, TCPA, ECOA, UDAPP regulations.
  • High aptitude for problem solving, analyzing data and interpreting contractual agreements.
  • Highly organized, able to work independently, motivated to successfully meet deadlines, detail oriented with a high level of accuracy and ability to multi-task.
Skills and Abilities
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar.
  • Handle multiple concurrent tasks.
  • Maintain appropriate records and compile information for reports.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.
  • Principles of supervision, training, and performance evaluation.
  • Work independently in the absence of immediate supervision.
  • Analyze problems, identify alternative solutions.
  • MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, etc..) at an intermediate level required.
  • Successfully pass pre-employment (post offer) background check.
Clearance

As a federal contractor, this position requires U.S. citizenship and security clearance granting access to classified information. The background investigation is conducted by the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and is an evaluation of the whole person to determine suitability. The suitability review begins after a conditional offer of employment has been accepted and will include a review of your employment, education, residences, references, criminal history and credit, as an example.  Some of the most important factors in an investigation are the individual’s honesty, candor, and thoroughness in the completion of their security forms. In rare instances, non-U.S. citizens with highly specialized skills and experience may also be considered for the security clearance process.

Security

Information and Physical Security is the responsibility of every employee.  In your position you are required to safeguard the computer systems by following proper username and password management which includes selecting challenging passwords and committing them to memory, they should not be written down or stored where others can freely have access.  This also includes securing your desk and workstation when you are not there. This includes locking your session and putting sensitive paperwork away when not physically at your desk.  You are not to share your username or password with anyone. The physical security of our offices of are equal importance, never shadow or let someone shadow your entry into a Coast Professional, Inc. facility. If this occurs quickly report this action immediately.  You are required to follow all Information Technology policies and procedures regarding the management of your system accounts and equipment. If you witness any security violation you should immediately report it to management.

Working Conditions

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the physical presence in the workplace is essential. The employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee frequently is required to use hands or finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

Disclaimer

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential job functions but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all activities, duties and responsibilities required by the job incumbent. Nothing in the herein restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. 

This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship. 

Coast Professional, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information or any other categories protected by applicable law.

data.title: Technical Writer & Specifications Analyst
data.description:
Key Responsibilities:
The Senior Technical Writer & Specifications Analyst is a hybrid role responsible for performing technical
business analysis—including requirements gathering and data mapping—and translating those requirements into high-quality,
developer-facing API specification documentation. This individual owns the complete lifecycle of documentation for our integration and
interoperability services, including orders and results services. Working directly with clinical, technical, product, and analysis teams,
they will define data specifications, construct mapping sheets, and build clear, user-friendly documentation to help both internal consumer
teams and external customers seamlessly integrate with Quest systems. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in healthcare standards
(HL7 and FHIR) and a proven background in simplifying complex integration workflows.

Key Responsibilities
• Responsible for analysis, design, coding and testing of new applications or Partner with technical, development, and product teams to gather, define, and document technical requirements for new and existing interoperability services.
• Create and maintain comprehensive, interactive API specification documentation (including schemas, endpoints, headers, and error codes) specifically for orders and results services.
• Perform detailed data mapping, interface specification design, and clinical data flow analysis (e.g., mapping HL7 segments/fields and FHIR profiles).
• Develop and maintain technical guides, quick-starts, step-by-step tutorials, and release notes for both internal developers and external customer IT teams.
• Validate technical specifications by actively testing APIs (using tools like Postman or curl) and reproducing integration workflows to ensure accurate documentation.
• Implement and manage a "Docs-as-Code" workflow, utilizing version control and markdown formatting to streamline review cycles and updates.
• Collaborate during Agile backlog grooming and sprint planning to proactively identify documentation and interface specification needs early in the product lifecycle.
• Standardize content across integration portals to ensure consistency, clarity, and adherence to both industry interoperability standards and brand style guides.
• Promote an environment that encourages collaboration, initiative, continuous improvement, learning, and the generation of innovative ideas and solutions. Required Skills & Qualifications
• 5 or more years of experience in technical writing, business systems analysis, or integration analysis, with progressive responsibilities in documenting APIs or clinical integrations.
• 3 or more years of experience in healthcare interoperability, with a focus on electronic health records (EHRs) and clinical data exchange.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience mapping HL7 standards (v2.x, v3) for orders, results, or clinical data.
• 3 or more years utilizing modern API documentation standards (such as OpenAI/Swagger) and API development tools (such as Postman).
• Experience with "Docs-as-Code" workflows and version control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub).
• Experience in healthcare interoperability in a diagnostic lab or clinical lab setting.
• Deep knowledge of HL7 standards specifically applied to lab workflows (LOINC, SNOMED, and lab-to-EHR resulting).
• Knowledge of and practical experience with Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) profiling and JSON data structures.
• Experience working in an Agile/SAFe environment.

Other Requirements:
Knowledge:
• In-depth knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, data structures, and clinical vocabularies (HL7, FHIR, JSON, XML).
• Knowledge of data-mapping techniques and technical requirements-gathering frameworks.
• Knowledge of API architecture styles (REST, SOAP) and security standards (OAuth 2.0).
Exceptional written communication, editing, and content design skills, with an extreme attention to detail.
• Deep technical proficiency and the ability to interview technical teams to extract crucial product mechanics.
• Experience with process Eligible to workimization, structured terminology management, and technical troubleshooting.
• Strong collaboration and consensus-building skills.
